purpose: Teach: マトリックス/パンダ/ウェールズ/マイホーム/ビーム/スピン/うなぎ/デイトレ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新しい在庫管理マトリックス、お洒落ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That new inventory system is really elegant, isn't it?
lines.style: Warm, genuine appreciation. Soft opening. Slight lift on the compliment — noticing something thoughtful someone did. Lingering on the last word like she's savoring it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、パンダのキャラ商品をお買いになったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer came in and bought those panda character goods today.
lines.style: Bright, animated delivery. Quick pace. A small note of delight in sharing something nice that happened. Leans forward slightly, like she's bringing Mei in on the good moment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様がウェールズ出身でいらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, and that customer was from Wales, actually.
lines.style: Thoughtful, conversational. Soft lift of interest on the detail. Not performing surprise — just offering something worth noticing. Gentle trailing-off, like she's wondering if that matters.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、マイホーム購入のお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of them was talking about buying a house soon.
lines.style: Quiet reflection. Steady pace. A note of wonder underneath — the significance of ordinary moments with customers. Soft, observant tone, like she's turning something over in her mind.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ライトのビームを下向きにしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Should we angle the lights downward a bit?
lines.style: Practical, matter-of-fact. Quick, efficient tone. Not a question that requires debate — a gentle suggestion from someone who's noticed something. Clear and purposeful.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、スピン技のアイススケート選手なのよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer's actually a competitive figure skater — does all those complicated spins.
lines.style: Animated, impressed. Energy picks up. Shares this like she's uncovering something delightful about someone ordinary. Light wonder in the pacing. Wants Mei to see it too.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューにうなぎのお重を加えようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should add eel donburi to the new menu.
lines.style: Eager but grounded. Forward momentum without rushing. Conviction on the idea — she's been thinking about this. Warm, inclusive tone: 'we' not 'you should.' Hopeful lift at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、デイトレで生計立ててらっしゃるんですって、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of them mentioned they make their living from day trading.
lines.style: Reflective, gently surprised. Slower pace. A note of recognition — the secret lives people live. Soft close, like she's quietly respectful of that kind of risk and independence. Fadeout on the last word.
